headline: ibyyue storms from 28th into ARC-2 gold

sections.text: ibyyue gained 15.00 points to reach 56.81, climbing from 28th to 12th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The surge carries ibyyue into the 15 gold places, now occupying 12th as the cutoff rises to 54.17.
